ISAIAH CHAPTER 37

Hezekiah mourneth, and sendeth to Isaiah to pray for them, Isa 37:1-5.

He comforteth them, Isa 37:6,7.

Sennacherib, called away against the king of the Ethiopians, sendeth a blasphemous letter to Hezekiah, Isa 37:8-13.

His prayer, Isa 37:14-20.

Isaiah’s prophecy, Isa 37:21-35.

An angel slayeth the Assyrians, Isa 37:36.

Sennacherib is slain at Nineveh by his own sons, Isa 37:37,38.
e: For the understanding of this, and the foregoing chapter, the reader is desired to consult my notes upon 2Ki 18:1-20:21.
